timeline.text: Every feature already had its own demo clip. The post about it? Just a photo.
Uploading it by hand, for every post, wasn't sustainable.
Posting video isn't like posting a photo -- LinkedIn makes you register the upload, then wait for it to finish.
Now one Supabase function does that itself, and posts the real clip instead.
If the upload fails, the post still goes out as text, instead of not going out at all.
